response.reason: The kernel correctly partitions K across splits with masked loads for non-divisible K (zero padding), accumulates in FP32, stores per-split partials, and the finish kernel sums partials and adds bias via index%N, which matches row-major column indexing. Coverage and masking handle all edge shapes (K=1, split_k > ceil(K/32), M/N up to 64) and the FP32 accumulation is within the stated tolerance for the bounded domain.
